description: Adform video, impression, and click tags on regional tracking domains, whose banner number rides as bn.

params.name: bn
params.description: It is the numeric Adform banner ID. Adform documents video tags as `{region}.adform.net/videoad/?bn=` plus that ID. Semicolon-delimited consent pairs may follow the number on click and impression tags. a2 is the Americas tracking domain, track is EMEA, a1 is global, asia is APAC.
params.fix_hint: Set `bn` to the banner ID from the Adform tag.
